item.title: Jason Kidd fined by NBA for expletive-laden rant towards media
item.description: Mavericks head coach Jason Kidd has been fined by the NBA for an expletive-laden rant after a recent loss.The NBA levied a $35,000 fine on Kidd for public criticism of officiating and using profane language in a media session.The rant came after the Mavericks lost to the Houston Rockets on Jan. 31.The rant came after a question about rookie Cooper Flagg playing minutes at point guard, which is not his standard position.
